nodes.guardrail: Before deepening economy/tech, verify no immediate threat by checking for enemy units near your base or production facilities. If threat detected, prioritize army production and defense over economy.
nodes.recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you observe the opponent's first combat units or at the 5-minute timing window.

nodes.guardrail: Before committing to ground army, confirm opponent remains ground-based (no air units or tech). If opponent shows air units or tech, prioritize adding anti-air or transitioning to air.
nodes.recheck_condition: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if you gain information about their tech path.

nodes.guardrail: Before continuing air investment, verify opponent lacks significant anti-air (e.g., Stalkers, Archons). If opponent builds anti-air, consider transitioning to ground or adding support.
nodes.recheck_condition: Re-evaluate if the opponent builds significant anti-air or if you need to transition back to ground.

nodes.guardrail: Before adding more tech (e.g., High Templar), ensure you have sufficient army to defend against potential pressure. If opponent shows air units, prioritize anti-air or transition.
nodes.recheck_condition: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if you need to adapt your composition.
